title: Sunray Haven | KEY.co
description_expanded: Located in the heart of Watersound, FL, this exquisite three-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bathroom townhome epitomizes luxury and convenience. The meticulously refreshed interior offers a fully equipped kitchen fit for a gourmet chef, boasting ample dishes, pots, pans, glassware, and servingware. The spacious living area features a 65" TV, perfect for cozy evenings. Each bedroom promises restful sleep with quality mattresses; the main bedroom offers a king bed and a 55" TV, the second bedroom has a queen bed and a 40" TV, and the third bedroom includes two twin beds. A high-end grill, an array of beach toys, and a brand-new 6-seater golf cart, affectionately named Toots McGee, elevate this home into a special retreat designed for memorable vacations. Set within the renowned Prominence community on Scenic 30A, guests can easily walk or bike to various attractions via a 17-mile bike path. The community is celebrated for its incredible amenities, including two resort-style pools, open green spaces, and a vibrant town center. The Big Chill, a local hotspot, features an outdoor 25 ft LED theater screen for movies and sports, surrounded by concerts, family activities, restaurants, and boutique shops. With close proximity to the stunning white beaches and popular areas like Seagrove, Seaside, Alys, and Rosemary Beach, this townhome offers a perfect blend of relaxation and adventure, ensuring an unforgettable stay.
